::: {.page-head}
# Teaching

I am passionate about teaching statistics and helping students develop intuition for statistical thinking. My teaching philosophy emphasizes connecting theoretical concepts to real-world applications, particularly in biomedical research.
:::

### Big Data Summer Immersion at Yale (BDSY)

[EHR Data Analysis Group Lead]{.role} · [Summer 2026]{.mono-date} · [bdsy.org/2026](https://www.bdsy.org/2026)

### National Tsing Hua University, Taiwan

[Graduate Teaching Assistant]{.role} · [2017–2021]{.mono-date}

- **STAT661000 Survival Analysis** (Spring 2020, Spring 2021)
    - Topics: Kaplan-Meier estimation, Cox proportional hazards model, time-varying covariates, competing risks
- **STAT519100 Applied Multivariate Analysis** (Spring 2017, Spring 2019)
    - Topics: PCA, factor analysis, clustering, discriminant analysis, MANOVA
- **STAT541000 Linear Models** (Fall 2018)
    - Topics: Linear regression theory, ANOVA, mixed effects models, diagnostics

[Undergraduate Teaching Assistant]{.role} · [2016–2020]{.mono-date}

- **ECON303300 Econometrics** (Fall 2019)
    - Topics: OLS, instrumental variables, panel data, limited dependent variables
- **STAT202000 Statistics** (Fall 2016, Spring 2020)
    - Topics: Probability, distributions, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, regression
